summary.text: Audio-visual speech separation methods often involve a large number of parameters and high computational costs, making them impractical for use as preprocessing steps in speech applications (paper:2509.23610). To address this, a lightweight encoder-decoder separator can be constructed by incorporating global-local attention blocks into each layer to efficiently capture multi-scale dependencies (paper:2509.23610). The underlying global attention mechanism uses a transformer architecture to integrate long-range semantic relationships and contextual information (paper:2509.20701).

target_user.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Machine learning engineers and speech processing researchers building low-latency on-device voice agents or audio preprocessing pipelines (repo:usefulsensors/moonshine, repo:alibaba-damo-academy/funasr).

jtbd.text: Perform efficient audio-visual speech separation and target speech extraction in noisy acoustic environments while reducing high computational costs (paper:2509.23610).

value_prop.text: Constructing an encoder-decoder separator with global-local attention blocks allows models to efficiently capture multi-scale dependencies and serve as a practical, deployable solution for high-performance audio-visual speech separation (paper:2509.23610).

riskiest_assumption.text: Given the feasibility score of 2.0 (dvf:12), the riskiest assumption is that integrating global-local attention blocks into a lightweight encoder-decoder structure can maintain or improve speech separation quality while drastically cutting parameters and MACs without suffering from training divergence or optimization instability.

mvp.text: Build a technical proof of concept by modifying an existing encoder-decoder separator using the transformers package (pkg:transformers) to incorporate global-local attention layers, and evaluate its speech separation throughput and parameter count against baseline models.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of at least a 2.0x reduction in MACs and 50 percent fewer parameters while maintaining competitive separation quality on benchmark datasets compared to standard separator baselines (paper:2509.23610, dvf:12).

kill_criteria.text: The model fails to achieve a proposed threshold of 2.0x faster GPU inference speed or exhibits a degradation in separation quality exceeding a proposed threshold of 15 percent relative to the baseline (paper:2509.23610, dvf:12).

open_source.use: Provides the foundational transformer model definitions and tooling for building the encoder-decoder architecture.
Provides optimization tooling for scaling and accelerating model training and inference execution.

to_build.text: A custom global-local attention block layer tailored for integration into the lightweight encoder-decoder separator to capture multi-scale dependencies (paper:2509.23610, dvf:12).
